getapikeyenvvars_provider_env_var_matrix.title: getApiKeyEnvVars provider→env-var matrix (prime-agent v0.7.0)
getapikeyenvvars_provider_env_var_matrix.content:
Repo: /home/bench/work/repo (prime-agent v0.7.0). `getApiKeyEnvVars(provider)` in packages/ai/src/env-api-keys.ts has exactly three decision points: two early returns (multi-element arrays) then one flat `envMap` Record lookup returning `envVar ? [envVar] : undefined`. Any provider absent from all three yields `undefined`.

Early returns (only sources of multi-element arrays):
- github-copilot -> ["COPILOT_GITHUB_TOKEN", "GH_TOKEN", "GITHUB_TOKEN"]
- anthropic -> ["ANTHROPIC_OAUTH_TOKEN", "ANTHROPIC_API_KEY"]

envMap single-element results:
google=GEMINI_API_KEY, google-vertex=GOOGLE_CLOUD_API_KEY, openai=OPENAI_API_KEY, azure-openai-responses=AZURE_OPENAI_API_KEY, prime-inference=PRIME_API_KEY, deepseek=DEEPSEEK_API_KEY, xai=XAI_API_KEY, groq=GROQ_API_KEY, cerebras=CEREBRAS_API_KEY, openrouter=OPENROUTER_API_KEY, vercel-ai-gateway=AI_GATEWAY_API_KEY, zai=ZAI_API_KEY, mistral=MISTRAL_API_KEY, minimax=MINIMAX_API_KEY, minimax-cn=MINIMAX_CN_API_KEY, moonshotai=MOONSHOT_API_KEY, moonshotai-cn=MOONSHOT_API_KEY, huggingface=HF_TOKEN, fireworks=FIREWORKS_API_KEY, opencode=OPENCODE_API_KEY, opencode-go=OPENCODE_API_KEY, kimi-coding=KIMI_API_KEY, cloudflare-workers-ai=CLOUDFLARE_API_KEY, cloudflare-ai-gateway=CLOUDFLARE_API_KEY, xiaomi=XIAOMI_API_KEY, xiaomi-token-plan-cn=XIAOMI_TOKEN_PLAN_CN_API_KEY, xiaomi-token-plan-ams=XIAOMI_TOKEN_PLAN_AMS_API_KEY, xiaomi-token-plan-sgp=XIAOMI_TOKEN_PLAN_SGP_API_KEY.

Returns undefined (OAuth/ambient-credential only, omitted from output): amazon-bedrock, openai-codex.

Gotchas: env var names do not track provider ids (vercel-ai-gateway -> AI_GATEWAY_API_KEY, huggingface -> HF_TOKEN); some regional variants share a var (moonshotai and moonshotai-cn both MOONSHOT_API_KEY) while others do not (minimax vs minimax-cn); AWS_* and GOOGLE_APPLICATION_CREDENTIALS are read by getEnvApiKey / hasVertexAdcCredentials, NOT returned by getApiKeyEnvVars; PRIME_TEAM_ID belongs to getPrimeTeamId and is not returned either.

KnownProvider union (packages/ai/src/types.ts) has 32 members; 30 map to non-undefined values. Result written to /home/bench/results/matrix.json in union order.

extract_ts_union_members_and_record_lite.title: Extract TS union members and Record literal entries by text parsing
extract_ts_union_members_and_record_lite.content:
For enumerating a large TypeScript string-literal union and cross-referencing it against an object/Record literal, read the .ts files as plain text and regex-parse instead of manually transcribing entries. This was the decisive technique for the getApiKeyEnvVars matrix (32 union members x 28 envMap entries) and eliminates transcription errors.

Procedure:
1. Slice the union: take source from `export type <Name> =` to the next `;`, then `re.findall(r'\"([^\"]+)\"', slice)` to get members in source order.
2. Slice the target function body by its declaration and the next sibling doc comment, then slice the literal from `const <mapName>` to the matching `};`.
3. Extract pairs with `re.findall(r'\n\t+\"?([A-Za-z0-9\-_.]+)\"?:\s*\"([^\"]+)\"', block)` — this handles both bare and quoted (hyphenated) keys.
4. Read remaining control flow (early returns, guards) by eye; only these produce values outside the literal.
5. Build the result iterating the union list so source order is preserved, and collect a separate `omitted` list for members absent from every branch. Print `omitted` as the correctness check.

Caveats: verify the function body slice does not run past the function's closing brace; confirm the literal has no spread/computed keys or fallthrough before trusting the regex; always sanity-check `len(union) == len(mapped) + len(omitted)`.

RLM-native use: `await ts_union_matrix.extract_union_and_map(...)`.

reference.call_pattern: members = re.findall(r'\"([^\"]+)\"', src[src.index('export type KnownProvider ='):].split(';')[0]); pairs = re.findall(r'\n\t+\"?([A-Za-z0-9\-_.]+)\"?:\s*\"([^\"]+)\"', map_block)

source_path.description: Absolute path to the .ts file containing the union or the Record literal.

union_name.description: Exported type alias name whose string-literal members should be enumerated, e.g. 'KnownProvider'.

function_name.description: Name of the function whose body contains the target literal, used to bound the slice, e.g. 'getApiKeyEnvVars'.

map_name.description: Identifier of the object/Record literal to parse, e.g. 'envMap'. Defaults to the first const object literal in the sliced body.
